Subject: Evaluation Pact — starter GDoc + slide outline for pilot MAP

Hi Kate —

Great to meet last week. Per our call I pulled together a brief "Evaluation Pact" (starter MAP) that lays out the artifacts, success metrics, and a suggested 6-week pilot timeline so we can align on what "done" looks. The doc is intentionally lightweight so we can iterate with your team.

High-level asks from Orbital: confirm the acceptance criteria column and assign a single technical owner for the pilot environment.

What I attached / shared:
- Evaluation_Pact_Starter_GDoc (editable) — sections: Objectives, Success Metrics, Stakeholders & Roles, Required Access, Pilot Timeline, Demo/Acceptance Checklist
- Pilot_Success_Metrics.xlsx — simple template to capture baseline vs. target latency/cost/quality metrics

Proposed next steps:
1) You review and add stakeholders by EOD Tue (6/1)
2) Quick 30m sync Wed (6/2) to finalize timeline and acceptance criteria
3) We slot a short internal enablement for your infra lead before the pilot (if needed)

GDoc (view/edit): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bEvalPactOrbital
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-ORB-043

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Evaluation_Pact_Starter_GDoc (link stub); Pilot_Success_Metrics.xlsx (link stub)

Date: 2027-05-31T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation Pact — starter GDoc + slide outline for pilot MAP

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the tidy template. A couple quick clarifying questions from our side before we assign stakeholders:

- Under "Required Access" you list token-level logs and per-route latency traces. Can you confirm if Redwood provides those out of the box in the Private deployment or would we need a connector?
- For the quality metric you suggested F1 on intent classification — we typically evaluate on human-rated relevance. Can you add a placeholder for a subjective rating column (1–5) we can populate?

We can do the 30m sync on Wed 6/2 at 11:00am PT. Luke (cc'd) will be our infra lead and should join.

Kate
VP Product, Orbital Systems
k.hartley@orbital.ai | (650) 555-2020

Next steps agreed:
- Orbital: add internal stakeholders to the GDoc and populate baseline metrics by Friday (6/6)
